query: Which dietary assessment protocol and calibration sub-sample produce the most reliable grams-of-fruit estimates across Nigeria and Vietnam?

response.query: Which dietary assessment protocol and calibration sub-sample produce the most reliable grams-of-fruit estimates across Nigeria and Vietnam?
response.answer: The 24-hour dietary recall protocol with calibration using weighed food records produces the most reliable grams-of-fruit estimates across Nigeria and Vietnam.
